_what: Example Lithuanian recall policy. Copy this shape into the LT_POLICY secret; do not commit a real one.
_rule: Excluded title term, or a code set entirely inside excluded divisions => drop. Missing title => keep. Otherwise keep when the title contains a recall_title_terms root. Codes never veto a matching title.
_roots: Lithuanian is heavily inflected, so every term is written as a root and matched as a substring: `spausdin` catches spausdinimo, spausdinimui, spausdinimas. This is the one thing the Lithuanian shape does that the Latvian one does not have to.
_note: The terms below are an unrelated illustration (office printing) chosen so that this file discloses nothing about any deployment's interests.
_overrides: Codes read anyway, wherever their division sits: a contract can carry a main code inside an excluded division and nothing else, and 62% of live procurements carry one code only.
